name: Raised Muffins
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Sift the flour into a pan with a pinch of salt
Warm the milk and add lard, and stir into the flour
Beat the eggs light, add to the mixture
Set to rise about three hours before using
When very light bake in muffin rings in a quick oven
Serve the instant they come from the oven
Tear the muffins open when done, put a bit of butter in each and keep warm until served

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift the flour into a pan with a pinch of salt
2. Warm the milk and add lard, and stir into the flour
3. Beat the eggs light, add to the mixture
4. When thoroughly mixed add yeast
5. Set to rise about three hours before using
6. When very light bake in muffin rings in a quick oven
7. Serve the instant they come from the oven
8. Tear the muffins open when done, put a bit of butter in each and keep warm until served
9. Never cut them
